label: tmpfs (court /tmp, 1 GiB), synthetic splitmix64 generator, single host, Rust court; not a device, filesystem-mount, or production-workload claim
non_claims: Codec-backed streaming (ZSTD/DELTA) is not implemented; large CodecAuto streams use a v2 raw chunk manifest.
read_object still materialises the whole file; range reads are chunk-bounded.
